title: Comfy Collab Prompt v1
description: A new creative prompt submitted to a ComfyUI collab session. Carries the prompt text, target Pinokio app (e.g. comfyui-desktop), and parent-prompt link for chain-of-edits. Published by creator-collab surfaces (notebook-workbench, creator-canvas-primary) and consumed by comfy-watcher / comfyui services to enqueue a workflow run.

room_id.description: Room manifest identifier the prompt targets (e.g. creator-studio).

session_id.description: P7 room session id this prompt belongs to.

prompt_id.description: Unique id for this prompt. Used as the correlation handle for follow-up progress + artifact events.

app_slug.description: Pinokio app slug the prompt targets (e.g. comfyui-desktop, ace-step, wan).

prompt.description: The creative prompt text. Free-form; length checked by app_slug-specific consumers, not the schema.

submitted_by.description: User handle, agent name, or service identifier that submitted the prompt.

submitted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the prompt was submitted.

parent_prompt_id.description: If this prompt is a revision, the prompt_id of the prompt it revises. Null for fresh prompts.

metadata.description: Optional app_slug-specific knobs (negative_prompt, seed, sampler, model, etc.). Free-form; consumers should ignore unknown keys.
